mapper.sql: id, refund_number, order_id, order_number, user_id, type, reason, description, amount, status, previous_status, admin_remark, audit_time, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: insert into mall_refund (refund_number, order_id, order_number, user_id, type, reason, description, amount, status, previous_status, create_time, update_time) values (#{refundNumber}, #{orderId}, #{orderNumber}, #{userId}, #{type}, #{reason}, #{description}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{previousStatus}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: update mall_refund set status = #{status}, admin_remark = #{adminRemark}, audit_time = #{auditTime}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: select count(*) from mall_refund where status = #{status}
